description: This file defines the Zend_XmlRpc_Server class which implements an XML-RPC server as part of the Zend Framework. It includes methods for attaching functions and classes, handling requests, loading functions, managing system methods, and handling exceptions related to XML-RPC calls.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Server
classes.description: A class implementing an XML-RPC server within the Zend Framework, providing methods to register functions/classes, handle requests, and manage system-related XML-RPC methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the server object and registers system methods.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Proxy method calls to the system object.

methods.name: addFunction
methods.description: Attach a callback function as an XML-RPC method, optionally namespaced.

methods.name: setClass
methods.description: Attach class methods as XMLRPC method handlers, optionally namespaced.

methods.name: fault
methods.description: Create and return an XML-RPC fault object based on an exception or message.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes an incoming XML-RPC request and returns the response.

methods.name: loadFunctions
methods.description: Load a set of functions or class methods into the server's dispatch table.

methods.name: setEncoding
methods.description: Set the character encoding for the server.

methods.name: getEncoding
methods.description: Retrieve the current character encoding for the server.

methods.name: setPersistence
methods.description: Placeholder for setting persistence; does nothing in this implementation.

methods.name: setRequest
methods.description: Assigns a request object to the server.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the current request object.

methods.name: setResponseClass
methods.description: Specify which class to use for forming responses.

methods.name: getResponseClass
methods.description: Get the class name used for responses.

methods.name: getDispatchTable
methods.description: Retrieve the server's dispatch table of methods.

methods.name: getFunctions
methods.description: List all registered functions/classes.

methods.name: getSystem
methods.description: Retrieve the system object managing system methods.

methods.name: sendArgumentsToAllMethods
methods.description: Configure whether arguments are sent to all methods or only constructors.

methods.name: _fixType
methods.description: Map PHP types to XML-RPC types.

methods.name: _handle
methods.description: Internal method to process an XML-RPC request.

methods.name: _registerSystemMethods
methods.description: Register system-specific XML-RPC methods.
